rules.DEADLINE: Deadline per band from the product's days_overdue: A (1-20) 5th business day after today (memo; policy said 7th); B (21-60) last business day of the current month, or of next month if today is that day; C (61+) 2nd business day after today.
rules.BDAY: Business days are Mon-Fri minus closure days 2026-12-24, 12-25, 12-28, 12-31, 2027-01-01 and 2026-11-30 (memo added); 2026-11-13 removed by the memo.
rules.FLOOR: Card 15% rounded up to next £5, min £30, capped at arrears; overdraft 20% (memo) rounded up to next £10, min £50, capped; loan instalment in A/B, full arrears in C.
rules.LADDER: Steps: arrears on 2nd business day after today, arrears on deadline, floor on deadline; dates clamped to deadline; opening ask counts as attempt 1; limits A 3, B 4, C 3; skipped repeats are not said but use an attempt.
rules.ORDER: Products handled overdraft, card, loan regardless of get_account order.
rules.IDENTITY: Postcode then year of birth; postcode in capitals with one space before the last three characters; the second wrong answer fails the check (policy beats the email's 'three goes').
rules.HARDSHIP: Hardship transfers straight to the care queue; close handed_over / hardship; no notes.
rules.CODES: Per-product codes from CL-12; dispute codes NO-DSP/NC-DSP replaced by NX-QRY from 2026-11-18 inclusive; NL-DSP unchanged; N-SYS for system failure.
rules.DISPUTE: A dispute ends only that product; later products treat the opening ask as refused; close no_promise with the first non-paid note's reason.
